description: Captioned inside the image: 'capture 1 - the screen as it was first drawn'. The reported dashboard on first draw: strip 1 has a red block at its end, strip 2 a teal block at its start, strip 3 a greyed-out block labelled 'off', strip 4 a blue block labelled 'pinned', strip 5 is purple end to end, and strip 6 has an amber block labelled 'flagged'. The caption is the only place the timing of the capture is stated; instruction.md does not repeat it.

Captioned inside the image: 'capture 2 - same screen after the window went behind another and came back to the front'. The red, teal, grey, blue and purple fills are all gone and those blocks are drawn like their neighbours; only the amber 'flagged' block is unchanged. Every block, its text and its position are the same as in capture 1. The caption is the only statement of what happened between the two captures.
